question: In Esophageal/GEJ trials, convert 'Type of therapy' into is_combination = true/false.
pred_sql:
SELECT
  "NCT",
  "Trial name",
  "Cancer type",
  "Type of therapy",
  CASE
    WHEN "Type of therapy" = 'Combination'
    THEN 'true'
    ELSE 'false'
  END AS is_combination
FROM clinical_trials
WHERE
  "Cancer type" = 'Esophageal/GEJ';
